siteBlock.Description of Business Type / Industry: Abecca Healthcare Limited designs and manufactures specialised, high-risk environment furniture for sectors such as mental health, corrections, and youth justice centers. The company focuses on a safety-first design philosophy, including features like foam-only structures and anti-ligature designs, and produces items such as anti-ligature mattresses, seating, tables, and bean bags from their factory in Pahiatua, New Zealand
siteBlock.Hazardous Substance Location: Type B storage at 82 Sedcole Street, Pahiatua, Pahiatua, 4910
siteBlock.Brief location summary: Abecca Healthcare Limited's manufacturing facility at 82 Sedcole Street, Pahiatua 4910, New Zealand, utilises various chemical agents in their manufacturing process that are classified under New Zealand's Hazardous Substances and New Organisms (HSNO) system. These substances include highly flammable liquids (3.1B), acute toxicity chemicals (6.1C/D), skin and eye irritants/corrosives (6.3A, 6.4A, 8.2B, 8.3A), sensitisers and chronic health hazards (6.5A/B, 6.7B, 6.9B), and ecotoxins harmful to aquatic life (9.1C).

findings.comment: The inventory register shows a maximum of 3,350 L of Class 3.1B is held on site. In accordance with Table 2 of Schedule 9, the trigger quantities are: 250 L (when in containers of more than 5 L) 500 L (when in containers of 5 L or less). Security controls in place are: Site access controlled by lock and key Site monitored 24/7 via CCTV Storage container secured with lock and key

The following hazardous substance classes are not present on site: All Class 1 substances (explosives) All Class 2 substances (gases) Class 3.2 substances All Class 4 substances (flammable solids) All Class 5 substances (oxidising substances/organic peroxides) Based on this inventory, there are no incompatibilities arising from these classes, as none are stored or used at the site.

Hazardous area not established A hazardous atmosphere zone should be established for flammable liquids in 100 L quantities in closed packages, according to the Interpretive Guide: Storing up to 2,000 L of Flammable Liquid in Closed Packages
The site plan shows the separation distance but does not show the hazardous area.
No evidence of hazardous area maintenance, electrical dossier, or certificate

A store that is a type B building: non-combustible (constructed of steel and with steel framing) The door to a store is: constructed of steel enable escape for persons inside the store is self-closing in the event of a fire near the doorway is kept closed except where goods are being placed in, or removed from, the store Quantity: 3,350 L Prescribed separation distance from protected place: 4.18m Package sizes 20L

The type B strage building stores 3,350 Class 3.1 substances in 5 and 20L containers. 3,000L are in 20L containers and 350L is stored in 5L containers. The prescribed separation distance, based on the Separation distances calculation tool provided by Worksafe, is more than 4.18m The separation distance verified on site visit was XXX, which is more than the 4.35m separation idndicated on the site plan
